Definition: properly, a butcher; hence, a lifeguardsman (because he was acting as an executioner); also a cook (usually slaughtering the animal for food)
BiblicalUsage: 1) executioner, cook, bodyguard, guardsman; 1a) cook (who also killed the animal for food); 1b) guardsmen, bodyguard
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
